children: Large XRP holders accumulated more than 470 million tokens worth about $724 million in five days, while U.S. spot XRP ETFs extended their inflow streak, according to BeInCrypto, with the products taking in $75.59 million in the week ending September 25. Whale balances rose from about 12.37 billion to 12.80 billion XRP as the token traded near $1.55 and tested resistance around $1.60.

title: XRP Whales Buy 470 Million Tokens As Spot ETF Inflows Continue
